abilities.name: Attack
abilities.text: Attack an enemy with your equipped weapon. Damage dealt is based on the weapon used. All characters start with this Ability. Use 1D4 if an Attack stat isn't listed on the item the character is holding or if the character is unarmed.

abilities.name: Recover
abilities.text: Attempt to recover from a status effect. Roll 1D10 and reduce the remaining power of a status effect by that amount. All characters start with this Ability.

masteries.name: Juggernaut
masteries.text: Your shield's block is also added to your roll.

masteries.name: Resilient
masteries.text: Your roll is increased by 2.

abilities.name: Heal
abilities.text: Target recovers [Healing] HP.

masteries.name: Life Shield
masteries.text: Healing done to someone who has full health is converted to temporary hp.

abilities.name: Protect
abilities.text: Grant the target [Healing] temporary HP. Temporary HP do not stack with subsequent casts.

masteries.name: Hemostasis
masteries.text: While the temporary HP exist the target will ignore 1 point of ongoing damage each round.

masteries.name: Protective Bubble
masteries.text: While the temporary HP exist the target has +1 armor.

masteries.name: Reflective Bubble
masteries.text: While the temporary HP exist the target reflects 1 damage at each successful.

abilities.name: Protection From Evil
abilities.text: Target gets +1 on all Defenses vs Status Effects and +1 to the power of Recover. This effect stacks with other bonuses to Defenses.

masteries.name: Unwavering Faith
masteries.text: Each time you are targeted by a status effect the bonus increases by 1.

abilities.name: Consecrate
abilities.text: Mark a 3x3 area centered on you. The area stays in place. Allies that stand in the area get a +1 on Luck rolls. Lasts 1 hour.

masteries.name: Holy Ground
masteries.text: The miss range of enemies standing in the area is increased by 2.

abilities.name: Magic Missile
abilities.text: Fires a bolt of pure magic energy at a target dealing [Magic] + 1D10 Arcane damage.

masteries.name: Barrage
masteries.text: You can spend Energy to fire additional missiles. Each Energy spent increases the number of missiles fired by 1. Limit 4 total missiles.

masteries.name: Charge-Up
masteries.text: You can increase the casting time to add power to your missile. Each extra action increases the power by 2. Limit +4 bonus from this effect.

abilities.name: Ray of Frost
abilities.text: Fires a ray of ice and freezing air at the target dealing [Magic] + 1D10 Cold damage.

masteries.name: Brain Freeze
masteries.text: The target's Magic is reduced by 1 until the end of your next turn.

masteries.name: Brittle
masteries.text: Your crit range is increased by 1 against the target until the end of your next turn.

abilities.name: Eldritch Blast
abilities.text: Blasts the target with dark magic dealing [Magic] + 1D10 Shadow damage.

masteries.name: Temporary Insanity
masteries.text: If you score a critical hit with Eldritch Blast the target is also stunned. The power of the stun is equal to the damage dealt by the spell.

masteries.name: Vampiric Touch
masteries.text: You are healed for 1 if Eldritch Blast does damage to its target.

abilities.name: Harm
abilities.text: Deals [Healing] +1D10 Shadow damage.

masteries.name: Transfer Harm
masteries.text: When you heal someone the power of your next Harm spell is increased by 1 for each 5 healing that was done, up to +5.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.text: Recover 2D6 HP. You can only use this ability once per battle.

masteries.name: Comeback
masteries.text: This ability now regenerates 1 Energy instead of costing 1 Energy.

masteries.name: Resurgance
masteries.text: The healing from this ability is doubled.

abilities.name: Clobber
abilities.text: Roll [Attack] vs target's Armor. If successful the target is stunned.

masteries.name: Bully
masteries.text: The power of your attacks is increased by 1 against stunned targets.

abilities.name: Heroic Strike
abilities.text: Attack for [Attack] + 1D10 damage.

masteries.name: Do or Die
masteries.text: The power of the attack is increased by 2 if you are under half health.

abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.text: Attack twice for [Attack] damage.

masteries.name: Overwhelm
masteries.text: Your attacks ignore 1 Armor against any enemies hit by Flurry until the end of your next turn. This effect stacks

abilities.name: Slam
abilities.text: Attack for [Attack] damage. If successful the target is also knocked back 1 square.

masteries.name: Devastating Slam
masteries.text: Slam also ignores 1 Armor.

masteries.name: Unrelenting
masteries.text: You may move with your target

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.text: Attack all enemies in front of you for [Attack] damage.

masteries.name: Heavy Swing
masteries.text: Enemies hit by Cleave are also knocked back 1 square.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.text: Attack all adjacent enemies for [Attack] damage.

masteries.name: Bladestorm
masteries.text: During your whirlwind you can move up to 2 squares. The whirlwind will hit any enemy that was adjacent to you on any of the squares you occupied during your attack.

masteries.name: Blade Flurry
masteries.text: The damage of Whirlwind is increased by the number of targets damaged by Cleave, up to a +5.

abilities.name: Go For the Throat
abilities.text: Critical range of all Techniques increased by 2.

abilities.name: Power Attack
abilities.text: You can add up to 5 to the power of any attack but for each point added you must roll an additional Luck roll. If any of the Luck rolls from this attack result in a miss then the attack misses. Only the first roll can grant a critical hit.

masteries.name: Focused Rage
masteries.text: If Power Attack is used for an attack that costs Energy, the miss range of all Luck rolls for that attack are reduced by 1.

masteries.name: Follow Through
masteries.text: The Attack of your next attack is increased by 1 for each 20 rolled during the additional Luck rolls of a Power Attack.

abilities.name: Lay on Hands
abilities.text: Touch a target transferring your HP to them. You choose how much HP to transfer. The amount transferred in one day cannot exceed your maximum HP.

masteries.name: Favored by the Gods
masteries.text: When you deal damage the healing of your next Lay on Hands is increased by 1. This effect stacks up to +5.

masteries.name: Guardian Angel
masteries.text: Once per day Lay On Hands can be used as an Interrupt Action when an ally drops below 1 hp. If you are not adjacent to them you will teleport to a space adjacent to them. Max range 6 squares

masteries.name: Lingering Faith
masteries.text: The target also receives 1 ongoing healing for the next 2 rounds. The healing occurs at the beginning of the target's turn before any ongoing damage.

abilities.name: Liberate
abilities.text: Attempt to free your target from a status effect. Reduce the power of any status effect on your target by [Magic] or [Healing].

masteries.name: Blessing of Freedom
masteries.text: If a nearby ally is afflicted by a status effect you may immediately cast Liberate as an interrupt action.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.text: Move up to 5 squares in a straight line to an enemy and attack them with a melee weapon.

masteries.name: Furious Charge
masteries.text: Power of next melee attack increased by 1 after using charge.

masteries.name: Bloodlust
masteries.text: Your first charge in each combat refunds the action spent if it deals damage.

abilities.name: Greater Influence
abilities.text: Range of Holy spells increased by 2.

abilities.name: Selfless Healer
abilities.text: Power of healing spells increased by 1 when cast on an ally.

abilities.name: Blessed Health
abilities.text: The power of diseases and poisons that affect you is reduced by 2.

masteries.name: Inoculation
masteries.text: Anytime you would be affected by a disease or poison flip a coin. On Heads you are not affected.

abilities.name: Unhindered
abilities.text: Miss chance of attacks against you increased by 2 when you have no armor penalty.

abilities.name: Armor Training
abilities.text: Penalty from wearing armor is reduced by 2. You can take this ability up to 3 times.

abilities.name: Prey on the Weak
abilities.text: +1 Attack against enemies with less than half health remaining.

abilities.name: Alacrity
abilities.text: Move is increased by 2.

abilities.name: Hit and Run
abilities.text: When your first action is a move action you can pause the move to take your second action and continue moving afterwards.

masteries.name: Blurred Speed
masteries.text: When you use Hit and Run your Dodge is increased by 2 until your next turn.

abilities.name: Improved Initiative
abilities.text: Whenever you roll for Initiative roll 2 D20s and use the higher roll.

abilities.name: Quick Draw
abilities.text: Once per round you can swap equipped weapons/shield as a free action on your turn.

abilities.name: War Cry
abilities.text: All allies within 5 squares get +1 to Attack for 10 turns.

abilities.name: Intimidating Shout
abilities.text: All enemies within 5 squares have their initiative reduced by 10.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.text: Teleport up to 6 squares away.

masteries.name: After Image
masteries.text: After using Blink, the miss range of attacks against you is increased by 1 until the end of your next turn.

abilities.name: Chaos Bolt
abilities.text: Fires a giant bolt of chaotic energy at a target dealing [Magic] + 1D10 Shadow damage. Ignores any Resist.

abilities.name: Reaping Strike
abilities.text: Deals [Attack] damage. Successful attacks against the target heal the attacker for 1.

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.text: Deals [Attack] damage. Successful attacks grant you 10 iniative.

abilities.name: Burning Hands
abilities.text: Fires a small explosion of fire from your hands, dealing [Magic] Fire damage to all in a 2x2 area.

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.text: Throws a ball of fire that explodes, dealing [Magic] + 1D10 Fire damage to all in a 5x5 area.

masteries.name: Overheat
masteries.text: Each cast of Burning Hands reduces the cost of Fireball by 1. The cost cannot be reduced below 0.

masteries.name: Lingering Flame
masteries.text: The damage of your next Fire spell is increased by 2 after casting this spell.

abilities.name: Temporal Burst
abilities.text: All enemies in a 5x5 area lost 1 action on their next turn.

abilities.name: Heroic Shout
abilities.text: All allies within 5 squares get an additional action on their next turn.

abilities.name: Holy Nova
abilities.text: All allies within 5 squares are healed for [Healing].

abilities.name: Smart
abilities.text: Magic increased by 1. This is intended to be a level 1 Ability that replaces the old racial modifiers.

abilities.name: Athletic
abilities.text: Attack increased by 1. This is intended to be a level 1 Ability that replaces the old racial modifiers.

abilities.name: Caring
abilities.text: Healing increased by 1. This is intended to be a level 1 Ability that replaces the old racial modifiers.

abilities.name: Tough
abilities.text: Your max Health is increased by 2. This is intended to be a level 1 Ability that replaces the old racial modifiers.

abilities.name: Spiritual
abilities.text: Your max Energy is increased by 1. This is intended to be a level 1 Ability that replaces the old racial modifiers.

abilities.name: Brawny
abilities.text: Attack increased by 2. Magic and Healing decreased by 1. This is intended to be a level 1 Ability that replaces the old racial modifiers.

abilities.name: Bookworm
abilities.text: Magic increased by 2. Attack and Healing decreased by 1. This is intended to be a level 1 Ability that replaces the old racial modifiers.

abilities.name: Naive
abilities.text: Healing increased by 2. Attack and Magic decreased by 1. This is intended to be a level 1 Ability that replaces the old racial modifiers.

abilities.name: Tank
abilities.text: Max Health increased by 4. Max Energy decreased by 1. This is intended to be a level 1 Ability that replaces the old racial modifiers.

abilities.name: Glass Cannon
abilities.text: Energy increased by 2. Max Health decreased by 2. This is intended to be a level 1 Ability that replaces the old racial modifiers.

abilities.name: Dual Weild
abilities.text: Abilities can now be used with 2 weapons at the same time. Their power is combined.

abilities.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
abilities.text: Attack, Healing, and Magic increased by 2 when using a 2-handed weapon.

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.text: You cannot lose more than half of your maximum Health from a single hit. Round the Health down if it is an odd number.

abilities.name: Steet Smart
abilities.text: Your Attack when using Light weapons is now equal to your Magic.

abilities.name: Summon Skeleton
abilities.text: Summons a skeleton with [Magic] Health. It can be instructed to attack or move as a standard action. The attack deals [Magic] damage and it moves 5 squares.

masteries.name: Armored Skeleton
masteries.text: The summoned skeleton now has 2 Armor.

abilities.name: Harvester Of Sorrow
abilities.text: Remove all ongoing damage from targets. Deals 1D6 damage and heals you for 1D6 for each effect removed.

abilities.name: Triage
abilities.text: Remove all ongoing damage effects from nearby allies.

abilities.name: Rejuvination
abilities.text: The target gains 1 ongoing healing for 10 rounds.

masteries.name: Lifebloom
masteries.text: Each time the Rejuvination heals, roll a D20. On 19 or 20, all allies within 5 squares are healed for 1.

abilities.name: Healing Surge
abilities.text: Heal target for [Healing]. The target pays the Energy cost instead of the caster.

masteries.name: Surge of Power
masteries.text: The target's Attack and Magic are increased by 2 until the end of their next turn.

abilities.name: Desperate Heal
abilities.text: The target is healed for [Healing] + 1D10. The power of this spell is reduced by 2 each time it is cast. The power resets at the end of a battle.

abilities.name: Touch of the Martyr
abilities.text: Sacrifice your own Health to heal the target. Roll 1D4 healing for each 1 Health sacrificed.

abilities.name: Steady Shot
abilities.text: Attack the enemy for [Attack] damage. The crit range of this attack is doubled. Requires a ranged weapon.

abilities.name: Roll the Bones
abilities.text: When using a Technique, you can increase the crit range by 1 - 4. For each point that you expand the crit range, the miss range of that attack will increase by 2.

abilities.name: Sleep
abilities.text: Roll [Magic] vs the target's Resist. If your roll is higher, the target falls asleep.

masteries.name: Lullaby
masteries.text: If the spell fails to put the target to sleep the power of the next cast is increased by 1. This effect stacks up to +5.

abilities.name: Daze
abilities.text: Roll [Magic] vs the target's Resist. If your roll is higher the target is stunned.

masteries.name: Stagger
masteries.text: When the target breaks free from the Daze effect, their movement is reduced by half until the end of their next turn.

abilities.name: Berzerker Rage
abilities.text: Until the end of battle or the character reaches 0 Health, they get 1 extra action each turn, can only use Techniques, and are immune to Fear effects. This costs all remaining Energy.

masteries.name: Ignore Pain
masteries.text: Reduce all damage taken by 1 while raging.

masteries.name: Seethe
masteries.text: When an enemy targets you with an Ability, the damage of your next Technique is increased by 1.

masteries.name: Frenzied Regeneration
masteries.text: Recover 1D4 Health each turn.

abilities.name: Summon Bone Golem
abilities.text: Summons a Bone Golem with [Magic] + 1D10 Health. The summoner can instruct it once per turn to attack for [Magic] + 1D10. Each attack costs 1 Energy. Can provide bones for Bone spells. Doing so reduces its Health by 1D6.

masteries.name: Excess Bones
masteries.text: Provides 1 free bone per turn.

abilities.name: Bone Spear
abilities.text: Deals [Magic] + 1D10 damage to a target. It can use bones within 10 squares, increasing the damage by 1 per bone used, max of 5.

masteries.name: Sharp Edge
masteries.text: Hits all targets in a straight line.

masteries.name: Serrated Edge
masteries.text: Increase critical damage by 1D10.

abilities.name: Bone Shield
abilities.text: Summons a shield with [Magic] Bones. Each bone reduces the damage of an attack by 1, using the bone in the process. The bones may be used by Bone spells.

masteries.name: Hardened Bones
masteries.text: Increase the damage reduction to 1D4.

masteries.name: Rib Cage
masteries.text: The caster can use multiple bones on 1 attack.

abilities.name: Bone Spikes
abilities.text: Deals [Magic] damage to a 2x2 area. Area is increased by 1 per bone used. Max area 6x6.

masteries.name: Nail to the Floor
masteries.text: Enemies that take damage are also rooted in place. Each root has Health equal to the damage taken.

abilities.name: Bone Wall
abilities.text: Creates a wall that blocks movement and attacks. The Health of the wall is 1D4 for each bone pulled. The wall can be spread over multiple squares. Each square must have 1 Health.

masteries.name: Jagged
masteries.text: Melee attacks cause the attacker to take 1 damage.

masteries.name: Sturdy
masteries.text: Increase the Health of the wall to 1D6 for each bone.

abilities.name: Smite
abilities.text: Attack an enemy for Holy damage. This is defended with the enemy's resist.

masteries.name: Retribution
masteries.text: The power of your next Smite is increased by 1 each time an ally within 6 squares takes direct damage from an attack or harmful spell.

masteries.name: Righteousness
masteries.text: The power of Smite is increased by 2 when used against undead or demons.
